facts.claim: The empire was founded by the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I.
The Virupaksha Temple is one of the oldest structures in Hampi.
The Vijayanagara Empire had no trade with foreign nations.
Krishnadevaraya was the most famous emperor of the Vijayanagara Empire.
The Golden Age of the empire saw extensive patronage of literature and arts.
The Vittala Temple contains musical pillars that produce different notes when struck.
The Stone Chariot at Hampi can actually be pulled and moved.
The Mahanavami platform was used by kings to watch the Dasara festival.
The Battle of Talikota took place in 1565 CE.
Following the battle, Hampi was pillaged and abandoned.
The empire fell because it was invaded by an army of stone giants.
Hampi is now recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site.
